title: Wellness — sleep, HRV, resting HR, weight
description: Daily wellness from core.daily_wellness and core.sleep_session (schema 006). Nullable columns (COMMENT ON TABLE core.daily_wellness): gaps are not zeros.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.resting_hr AS "Resting HR (bpm)", w.hrv_last_night_avg AS "HRV overnight (ms)" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date

SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.weight_kg AS "Weight (kg)" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND w.weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date

panels.title: Sleep stages
panels.description: core.sleep_session is keyed by the WAKE date (wake_date), not the bedtime date (COMMENT ON TABLE core.sleep_session).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.wake_date::timestamp AS time, s.deep_s AS "Deep (s)", s.light_s AS "Light (s)", s.rem_s AS "REM (s)", s.awake_s AS "Awake (s)" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(s.wake_date) ORDER BY s.wake_date
SELECT s.wake_date::timestamp AS time, s.sleep_score AS "Sleep score" FROM core.sleep_session s WHERE s.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(s.wake_date) ORDER BY s.wake_date

SELECT w.local_date::timestamp AS time, w.body_battery_high AS "Body Battery max", w.body_battery_low AS "Body Battery min", w.avg_stress AS "Average stress" FROM core.daily_wellness w WHERE w.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date
